Texts from the thesis Notion page (Stockholms tunnelbana – highlights). complexity: 1 easy, 2 medium (branch / easy to miss), 3 complex. photo: file in assets/b/stations/ (credits in credits.json there). discoverUrl: page opened by DISCOVER (null = not built yet).

T-Centralen|Stockholm.description: Blue-and-white cave walls with climbing vines and silhouettes of the workers who built the metro.

Kungsträdgården|Stockholm.description: An underground excavation site in red, white and green, with sculptures and relics of Makalös Palace.

Rådhuset|Stockholm.description: A huge pink and rust-red rock cave with historic objects set into its walls.

Solna centrum|Solna.description: A deep red cave ceiling above a green forest, about nature and society.

Solna strand|Solna.description: Blue 'sky' cubes set into the rock walls of a surreal cave.

Rissne|Sundbyberg.description: A long timeline with maps, running from ancient times to today.

Tensta|Stockholm.description: Words in many languages about migration, solidarity and living together.

Hallonbergen|Sundbyberg.description: Children's drawings turned into walls full of childhood memories.

Husby|Stockholm.description: Colourful public art about the local community.

Östermalmstorg|Stockholm.description: Siri Derkert's wall drawings on peace, women's rights and the environment.

Stadion|Stockholm.description: A vaulted ceiling painted in sweeping rainbow arcs.

Tekniska högskolan|Stockholm.description: Science, space and geometry, with installations hanging from the ceiling.

Mörby centrum|Danderyd.description: Wall colours that change as you move along the platform.

Universitetet|Stockholm.description: Tiles with words and images on science, nature and human rights: a station to read as you walk.

Thorildsplan|Stockholm.description: 8-bit video-game tiles with pixel clouds and mushrooms.

Hötorget|Stockholm.description: 1950s architecture and light art with a strong retro feel.

Bagarmossen|Stockholm.description: Modern public art, quite different from the classic cave stations.
